name: Kiro
description: Space Capsule V11.0 — Runtime Efficiency Suite: Minigame 60 FPS Cap, Batched Canvas Draw Calls & O(1) Particle Pool
changelog: V11.0: 5-fix performance suite — minigame guard moved to top of RAF loop (eliminates circadian trig during gameplay), 60 FPS cap on all minigame loops (saves 50-75% GPU on high-refresh panels), Tetris grid batched from 28 individual strokes to 2 paths, NebulaDodge plasma jets batched by color group eliminating per-object save/restore flushes, and ParticlePool upgraded from O(n) linear scan to O(1) free-list head pointer.
